items.title: Live: Henderson 'not going to apologise' for test calls to Triple Zero, Telstra CFO says service now restored
items.description: Telstra says services have been restored after its mobile network suffered a nationwide outage on Wednesday morning. Follow live.

items.title: Broken timers trigger nationwide Telstra outage
items.description: Telstra says Wednesday's nationwide outage was caused by malfunctioning "nodes" that manage time synchronisation within some of the network data centres, but has no idea what caused the timer issues.

items.title: Live: Maroons host Blues in State of Origin decider
items.description: The State of Origin series will be settled in tonight's Game III decider, as Queensland hosts New South Wales at Lang Park in Brisbane. Follow live.

items.title: Australian 'alien' arrested after ICE investigation, Trump says
items.description: An Australian woman has been arrested in the United States after an ICE investigation allegedly found she had illegally voted in multiple federal elections.

items.title: More than 120 NSW crown prosecutors take rare step over DPP report
items.description: Senior crown prosecutor Brett Hatfield SC issued the extraordinary statement on behalf of the more than 120 barristers who take on cases for the crown.

items.title: World Cup quarterfinals are upon us. Here's what you need to know
items.description: The World Cup has whittled 48 teams down to just eight, with the quarterfinals upon us and the finish line in sight. Find out all you need to know about these monumental matches.

items.title: RBA chief economist warns of more frequent supply shocks
items.description: The Reserve Bank's Sarah Hunter says global supply shocks appear to be occurring more frequently and the RBA will try to adjust to the new reality.

items.title: Iran targets sites in Bahrain and Kuwait after wave of US strikes
items.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards target US military sites in Bahrain and Kuwait after the US launched a wave of military strikes on Iran.

items.title: The faces in the crowd at the Ayatollah's funeral
items.description: The strictly choreographed funeral of Iran's former supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has presented a rare insight into the image Tehran wants to project to the world and the men they see as central to it.

items.title: Bondi survivor says YouTube's 'false flag' video decision 'inexplicable'
items.description: Arsen Ostrovsky has criticised a decision by YouTube to keep a video on its platform, in which creators suggested he had lied about his injuries from the Bondi Beach terror attack.

items.title: Foreign investor snub of divestment order 'extraordinary', says expert
items.description: China-linked investors in a Western Australia rare earths company have yet to comply with federal Treasurer Jim Chalmers's latest order to sell their shares.

items.title: Critical drugs could be pulled from PBS amid pricing stoush
items.description: The latest PBS stoush with drugmakers means thousands of people with MS are at risk of being forced to pay $33,000 a year for lifesaving medication.

items.title: SA confirms second H5 bird flu case, two more suspected in Perth and WA
items.description: South Australia confirms its second H5 bird flu case while Western Australia investigates two more suspected detections, as authorities say the virus has not spread beyond isolated wild birds.

items.title: New York high-rise at risk of 'collapse' after columns buckle
items.description: The former headquarters of pharmaceutical giant Pfizer was being converted into luxury apartments when buckled interior columns were discovered inside the building.

items.title: A bus, a solar-powered stage and a journey across remote Australia
items.description: The Guts tour is a roaming, solar-powered convoy that snakes its way through some of the most remote communities in the Northern Territory, bringing together bands from the city and the bush.

items.title: Quiz: Jump in, we're going on a trip around the world
items.description: Which Mediterranean island was a setting for The Godfather? And what's the capital city of Morocco?

items.title: The 'amazing' turnaround in literacy at this primary school
items.description: An inspiring turnaround at an Aboriginal community school could provide a scalable solution for closing the gap on Indigenous literacy.

items.title: 'I want to clear my name': Former NSW minister charged with misconduct
items.description: Former New South Wales Liberal government minister John Sidoti says he will fight a charge of misconduct while in public office.

items.title: Vape battery sets man's pants on fire in Byron Bay
items.description: A Brisbane man visiting Byron Bay has been left with burns after a lithium-ion battery ignited in his pocket.

items.title: Qld business fined $1,200 after sparking million-dollar fire ant scare
items.description: The unnamed business shipped a pallet of second-hand bricks infested with fire ants to mine sites in the Bowen Basin in mid-2025, sparking four rounds of aerial baiting at a cost of $1 million.

items.title: Aussie doubles fly the flag at Wimbledon as mixed pair makes final
items.description: Marc Polmans and Storm Hunter win through to the Wimbledon mixed doubles final, as Thanasi Kokkinakis flies the flag in the men's doubles.

items.title: With women's game short on resources this AFLW player went to Doha for ACL rehab
items.description: Essendon AFLW forward Emily Gough said devastating ACL injuries can get lost in the sheer amount of them in women's game.

items.title: Teammates of Melbourne footballer will sit next match out after death
items.description: Epping football club's reserves players have decided to skip this weekend's game following the death of their beloved teammate Nathan Fitzgerald on Monday night.

items.title: Proposed building code throws Qld construction industry into 'confusion'
items.description: Queensland Council of Unions general secretary Jacqueline King has called on Deputy Premier Jarrod Bleijie to explain the proposed changes to the industry.

items.title: Fugitive prisoner with alleged links to bikie gang arrested in rural Darwin
items.description: Northern Territory police officers have arrested Isaac Thompson, 26, in Darwin River, more than 48 hours after he escaped custody during a medical transfer.
